verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents an official `dg` CLI that covers transcribing files, streaming live audio, synthesizing speech, analyzing text, and managing projects, keys and usage. It has AI-native features: switchable output formats, scriptable exit codes for CI, shell completion, auto-detection of agent environments like Claude Code and Codex, and a built-in MCP server. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working in practice.
